source.surface: failure inside a two-step flow, with the flow's own progress indicator still visible
source.attribution: Screen curated by Mobbin (https://mobbin.com). Inspected remotely through the Mobbin MCP under accessMode 'remote-mcp'. No image was downloaded, cached, embedded, or stored anywhere in this repository; every value below is our own reading of the rendered screen.

evidenceTier.rationale: Mobbin is a curated gallery of captured screens. It is not a live observation we made of a running product, and no audience outcome is attached, so it cannot be silver/M2 or gold/M3. Treat these facts as evidence that a shipped product once looked this way, not as evidence that it worked.

decisionColour.acceptControlTreatment: solid dark green fill with a white label
decisionColour.rejectControlTreatment: none; a close glyph at the top right is the only exit
decisionColour.undecidedContainerTreatment: the failure message area is plain white with no tint, but the step indicator at the foot of the page still shows step 1 as a filled green check
decisionColour.verdict: A mixed instance. The failure region itself is neutral and the recovery button is the only filled control, which is correct. But a success-coloured completion marker survives on the same screen: the green tick on step "Login" persists while the flow is in a failed state, so one region of the page asserts progress while another reports failure. This is the failure mode our own trust-surfaces gate exists to catch, occurring in a shipped product.
